$description: BASE theme (decision B1: fully neutral/generic). Defines the complete default that every surface inherits. Brand tokens here are a professional neutral blue — NOT any specific company's brand. A tenant theme overrides only the keys in themes/_template.json and inherits everything else. This maps to the :root defaults in dist/tokens.css.

brand.$description: The generic default brand ramp. Neutral, vendor-independent.

font.display: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

chart.$description: Inherits the generic validated template from ../chart-palette.json. Base does not override it.
